emma-sales: Quick question 8) I attended DevSummit SF for 3 days and the company paid hotel & flights on the corp card, but meals I paid out-of-pocket. Policy says per-diem OR actuals for conferences. Which should I submit?

rafael-finance: Hi Emma 1FE0F - if you choose per-diem we reimburse a flat rate for meals based on city/day and you don't need receipts. If you choose actuals, attach itemized receipts for any meal over $25. Which do you prefer?

emma-sales: Curious whether per-diem covers the conference evening networking reception that had a $60 cover. Also I grabbed breakfast on Day 2 at a coffee shop ($12) and lunch was $28 (no itemized receipt, just a card swipe).

claire-hr: Per policy: per-diem covers meals & incidentals. If you claim per-diem, you should NOT also submit meal receipts. The networking reception is ok under per-diem. If you want actuals instead, we need itemized receipts for the $60 and $28.

tom-corpcard: FYI the corp card policy blocks restaurant charges over $150 without manager approval, but that doesn't affect per-diem.

emma-sales: Hmm I don't have an itemized receipt for the $28 lunch (only a charge on my bank app). Can I still submit actuals?

rafael-finance: For actuals we need some proof of purchase. A bank statement screenshot showing merchant name + amount is acceptable for small meals, but if unclear we may ask for manager approval. You can also opt for per-diem to avoid the frict.

claire-hr: Manager approval note: if you submit actuals and some items are missing proper receipts, manager can sign an exception stating "receipt lost" and certifying business purpose. That speeds approval.

emma-sales: Ok I'll do per-diem to keep it simple. How many days count? I traveled 6/10 evening, conference 6/11-6/13, left 6/13 afternoon. Do partial travel days get full per-diem?

rafael-finance: Per-diem rules: full per-diem on conference days (6/11, 6/12, 6/13) and 75% per-diem on travel days if travel includes main meal times. The overnight arrival day (6/10) counts as travel day at 75%. So total = 3 full + 1 partial. Use SF per-diem rate $74/day. So reimbursement = (3 * 74) + (0.75 * 74) = $259.50. Submit in Ramp as "Per-diem - Conference" GL 6135.

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Reminder  Please attach travel itinerary + conference agenda for per-diem. No meal receipts needed. Submit within 30 days.

emma-sales: Thanks all - submitting now and attaching agenda. :raised_hands:
